story_title: Lina and Adams and the Seashell Beach
title: Lina and Adams and the Seashell Beach 🐚 | Learn Beach Words in English for Kids | Moon Tales Kids
description:
Come to the beach with Lina, Adams and Milo! 🏖️🐚🌊
In this English story for kids, children learn 8 new words: beach, sea, sand, wave, shell, castle, boat and hot. Listen, repeat, and learn English with Lina, Adams and Milo the cat.

📚 New words in this story:
🏖️ beach — الشاطئ — la plage
🌊 sea — البحر — la mer
⏳ sand — الرمل — le sable
🌊 wave — الموجة — la vague
🐚 shell — الصدفة — le coquillage
🏰 castle — القلعة — le château
⛵ boat — القارب — le bateau
🔥 hot — حار — chaud

👨‍👩‍👧 For parents: play the story, pause after each new word, and ask your child to say it out loud. Perfect for ages 3 to 8 and for children learning English as a second language.

🇲🇦 قصص باللغة الإنجليزية للأطفال لتعلم كلمات جديدة بطريقة ممتعة.

lines.text: It is a bright summer morning. Lina and Adams are so excited.
Today we go to the beach! Hooray!
I have my hat, and I have sandwiches for lunch.
Milo the cat wants to come too. Meow!
A beach is a place next to the sea, with lots of sand.
Say it with me: beach!
They arrive at the beach. Wow! Look at all that water!
The sea is so big and so blue!
I can see it all the way to the sky!
The sea is a very, very big area of salty water.
Say it with me: sea!
Milo sniffs the air. It smells salty. Meow!
Lina takes off her shoes. Ouch, ouch!
The ground is very hot! The sun made it warm.
Let's put on our hats and drink some water.
When something is very warm, we say it is hot.
Say it with me: hot!
Remember: on a hot day, wear a hat and drink water.
Lina and Adams sit down near the water.
The sand is soft. It feels like little tiny stones!
I can make a hand print in the sand. Look!
Milo makes paw prints. One, two, three, four! Meow!
Sand is made of very small grains. We find it on the beach.
Say it with me: sand!
Let's build something with the sand!
Let's build a castle, with big tall towers!
They dig and pat and shape the sand together.
You make the towers, and I will make the door.
A castle is a big house for kings and queens. A sand castle is made of sand.
Say it with me: castle!
Whoosh! The water comes up on the sand.
Oh no! A wave is coming to our castle!
The wave washes away one tower. Splash!
That's okay, Adams. We can build it again, together.
A wave is water in the sea that goes up and comes down.
Say it with me: wave!
And this time, they build the castle a little further from the water.
Lina finds something pretty in the sand.
Look! A shell! It is pink and white, and round like a fan.
I found a shell too! It is long and curly.
A shell is the hard little house of a sea animal.
Say it with me: shell!
Let's put the shells on our castle. It looks beautiful!
Far away on the sea, something is moving.
Look, a boat! It has a white sail.
Hello, boat! Let's wave our hands. Hello!
A boat carries people on the water.
Say it with me: boat!
The people on the boat wave back. How kind!
Now it is time to go home.
Let's take our things with us. We keep the beach clean.
I will carry the bag. You carry the hats.
They put every little paper in the bag. Good job, friends!
Milo walks behind them, his tail high. Meow!
At night, Lina and Adams remember their happy day.
We saw the sea, we played in the sand, and we built a castle!
And we found shells, and we saw a boat on the waves.
Lina puts her pink shell next to her bed.
Good night, sea. Good night, Milo.
Good night, everyone!
